name: Jelly5
description: A native Jellyfin client for jailbroken PS5: its own liquid-glass interface, hardware-decoded 4K HDR
author: 02dnot
release_notes:
Two fixes.
- Sound in sync after a seek: skipping far ahead in a long film could leave the sound behind the picture until the video was reopened. Fixed.
- Subtitles follow your server's setting: with subtitles set to Always but no preferred language (or an external subtitle file without a language), subtitles started off. Jelly5 now starts on the subtitle your server picks for you, as the server's own apps do.

Update: close Jelly5 with the PS button, then upload the new PPSA99505 folder's files over the old ones in /data/homebrew/PPSA99505/ (with ps5upload or FTP). Your accounts and settings are kept.
